description: For a sentence theory \(T\) in a countable first-order language, syntactic consistency in the stated proof calculus is equivalent to existence of a nonempty model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.LargerModels.consistent_iff_satisfiable.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Countable L.Symbols] {T : L.Theory} : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T ↔ T.IsSatisfiable
